description: The analytics event catalog — the documented taxonomy. Counts and timings only: no event ever carries what a visitor typed (no email, no free text).

events.section_view: A landing section scrolled into view (props: section).
events.cta_open_web: The 'Open Kro on the web' call to action was pressed (props: placement).
events.cta_early_access: An early-access call to action was pressed (props: placement).
events.early_access_submit: The early-access form was submitted (props: platform, source).
events.early_access_joined: The early-access request succeeded (props: platform, hasPosition).
events.platform_vote: A platform was picked in the platform picker (props: platform).
events.faq_open: A FAQ entry was expanded (props: question index).
events.outbound: An outbound link was followed (props: destination host).
events.theme_toggle: The light/dark toggle was used (props: theme).
events.nav_open: The mobile navigation menu was opened.
